title: Clear Search Results on Close Button
body:
Hi,

I would like to clear the search field when I click on an "X" button

So far I'am able to clear the input field using jquery but the results are still there

When I use my backspace to empty the input field though the search results goes away

comments.body:
Hi Guys,

A little follow up

Since we now able to successfully clear the input :)

Can we also return the URL state after a query is was done?
You can use `location.search` (a DOM API) to get the current querystring, see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils/search

Anyway we can utilize something here?

https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/
